eps.d: Maigret investigates the murder of a stripper, finding himself mixing with the low life types of Montmartre.
A model electric train salesman tells Maigret that his wife is trying to murder him. Maigret doesn't believe him until he is found dead.
During a break-in, a safecracker finds something he wasn't expecting.
Maigret is faced with a strange situation when his revolver is stolen and seems likely to be used for attempted murder.
Conflicting reports of a maid's death take Maigret to Normandy to investigate the charming Madame Besson and her children.
No one knows what William Brown does when he visits Cannes every month, but one day he returns with a knife in his back.
Emile Gallet was a man who preserved his way of life and provided for his dependants, but he is later found shot in Sancerre.
A savage murder on the Mediterranean island of Porquerolles provides a change of scene for Inspector Maigret.
Professor Gouin, a brilliant surgeon, but a man that 'does not know what makes people tick', is caught in the drama of murder.
Maigret's wife is hospitalised whilst on holiday, which leads him to investigate a crime to pass the time.
Maigret runs into the tough methods of American gunmen when mafia gangsters arrive in Paris to carry out a hit on an informer.
After Lapointe is shot at and injured outside an apartment house, Maigret takes up temporary residence so he can investigate undercover.
Maigret investigates the lives of three seemingly respectable citizens after observing some suspicious behaviour,
Maigret investigates the murder of a man who was killed in his office and his safe ransacked.
The owner of a bistro is nowhere to be found when a dismembered corpse is found by the river near his establishment.
A wealthy meat trader who is also an old school friend of Maigret's, asks for police protection.
Maigret hunts down a ruthless gang, with only a few clues to help him solve a puzzling crime.
Maigret works on a case with his old rival, the constantly miserable Inspector Lognon.
Old Joris wanders through the maze of Paris lost and speechless . . . and with a bullet wound in his head.
Maigret investigates a strange accident, noticing that the men of the Paris canals do not take well to interference.
When expected to give evidence at a murder trial, Maigret gets a feeling that the accused may actually be innocent.
Maigret travels to a coastal village to investigate the murder of the postmistress, with the schoolmaster being the main suspect.
Father Christmas displays a strange interest in the floorboards when visiting the house across from the Maigret's.
An old, dilapidated mansion is burgled and Maigret discovers a disturbing reason why a family is reluctant to talk.
Conflict arises between Maigret and a defence lawyer who is determined to score points in the media at the police's expense.
Maigret untangles a strange secret after a man who usually leaves for and returns from work like clockwork fails to return.
Maigret is thrown into a world where he must tread delicately when investigating the violent death of Count St. Hilaire.
Maigret must fall on unconventional methods to catch a madman after being wounded and confined to a hotel bed.
Maigret returns to the village where he was born and becomes convinced he witnessed the Countess of Fiacre's murder.
A story told in the death cell takes Maigret to a mock wedding where he gains a clue to solving an old murder.
Maigret must seek out an individual who is attempting to destroy the reputation and career of a government minister.
The prime suspect in a village murder case is the victim's maid; Maigret gains a liking for her, but is she guilty?
An arrogant old lady pays Maigret a visit and tells him about the death of her granddaughter.
Maigret investigates the murder of a fortune teller after the prediction of their own death comes true.
Maigret descends upon a small town north of Paris after a diamond dealer is found murdered in the garage of a house.
A rich old woman and her maid have been murdered. Maigret allows the prime suspect to escape custody to learn the truth.
The young son of a murder suspect leads the police on a clever trail. Is he purposely hindering or helping the case?
Maigret creates a trap to capture a serial killer who is targeting women in the streets of Montmartre.

Maigret holds the suspicion that a recently released criminal is responsible for a number of daring robberies in Paris, but his attention is divided when Inspector Fumel brings an intriguing murder to his notice.
Cecile has a crush on Maigret; he doesn't believe her story about a midnight intruder, until she's murdered.
Maigret discovers local prejudices run deep when investigating a series of murders in the town of Fontenay.
To Inspector Lognon the life lost was just another murder to be solved, but it meant more than that for Maigret.
An American millionaire's French wife is murdered at the luxurious Majestic Hotel.
Tomorrow a man must die on the guillotine, unless Maigret can demolish the case he himself built up against him.
Maigret discovers similarities between himself and a killer, finding there is only one way to gain a confession.
Maigret takes on a mystery surrounding a gunshot in a silent, sleeping house exposing a ruthless battle for power.

eps.t: The Log of the Cap Fagnet
eps.d: A conspiracy of silence protects the murderer of Captain Fallut. Can Maigret find any significant clues?
The peculiar logic of madness that haunts the Judge's house, helps Maigret to solve the puzzling murder of a doctor.
When investigating the murder of millionaire David Ward, Maigret enters another world, where money is lord of all.
A yacht and a barge meet in the traffic of the canals, with their passing resulting in murder.
An alarming piece of news makes its way to Maigret - one of the most dangerous criminals in Europe is now in Paris!
The exposed body of a doctor's wife is discovered, and the crime attracts a barrage of anonymous letters.
